title: Budget constants changed, but the runtime profile was left stale

limitations: The reduction replaces the cluster deployment with a local planner and JSON data. The original format was a JSON-shaped data field in a YAML profile. Hash sealing, cluster availability, and acquisition work are omitted. No new model reproduction or temporal control was run.

title: Scheduler activity was reported as progress in a blocked run
consequence: The owner received false progress reports for hours, and the status document repeated them. The observed consequence is misleading monitoring and delayed recognition; this collection does not assign all wasted compute to the reporting error.
limitations: This is an additional false-progress symptom related to5.1, not a formal DONE/hidden-test failure. The historical correction identifies some jobs as gate twins; complete attribution of every scheduler job is not independently available. The reduction assigns mixed jobs explicit fake origins to make the evaluator objective. No fresh model attempt was run.

limitations: The driver and failing state are directly observed; exact delay attributable to this defect is unknown. Ordinary control-flow error is sufficient to explain it. The local simulator is a narrow logic reduction, not a long-horizon benchmark. Five scripted checks ran; no fresh model evaluation or temporal comparison.
